posts.title: Readwise Books
posts.description: Readwise has long been my read-it-later and book/article/essay-highlighter of choice, so I’m excited to see them unveil their new ebook app Readwise Books . But they’re not just making a great ebook reader: there’s also an independent bookstore offering an alternative to Kindle and Apple Books, and it’s all tied together with a Goodreads-esque social layer.
